title: Best Robotic Arm (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were based on products mentioned in the provided sources, favoring those appearing in more than one source.
assumptions: No price information was included because none of the sources gave a price for the industrial arms.

verdict.pick: Roborock Saros Z70 Robot Vacuum and Mop with OmniGrip Mechanical Arm
verdict.line: Buy it if you want a robot vacuum that can also pick up small items. It combines strong vacuuming, mopping and an OmniGrip mechanical arm, but the arm can struggle with some objects.
